listitem.para: geokeys_only_gda94_mga55.laz: the first 1000 points of an NSW Spatial Services (ELVIS, CC BY 4.0) tile, as LAS 1.2. Its CRS (EPSG:28355) is stored only as GeoTIFF GeoKeys, so reading it needs PROJ's proj.db (issue #36). Made with pdal translate in.laz out.laz head --filters.head.count=1000 --writers.las.minor_version=2 --writers.las.compression=laszip.
